• **JoJo is carrying too much.** At 153 sessions (excluding scans: 129 real coaching hours), she's running nearly double Eilis's load. Move some of JoJo's Build: Upper and Circuits classes to Eilis to balance and reduce burnout risk on your Head Coach.

• **Elevate is under-covered.** Only Eilis and Grace currently teach it (12 + 3 sessions). Since Grace is stepping back, build Elevate into JoJo's rotation—it suits her technical expertise and spreads the signature class across two coaches for resilience.

class_stats.suggestion:
**Fill quiet studio time:**

1. **Add a paid open-gym block on Monday/Thursday evenings** (your quietest days) between PT slots—members often want flexible barbell time outside structured classes, and this captures demand without scheduling another fixed class.

2. **Create a 30-min "Capacity Primer" workshop slot** on a Tuesday or Wednesday morning before a Build class—Capacity is severely underattended (19 in last 30 days); a short, free intro session teaching the format/benefits will de-risk the full class for hesitant members.

**Lift the quieter classes:**

3. **Move Engine and Barbelle to Friday late afternoon/evening**—Friday's your third-busiest day but still 100+ members below Tuesday/Wednesday; members already in-gym for daytime classes may stay for a complementary conditioning or barbell class, and evening slots often suit working members who skip daytime options.
